title: SSC CGL Tier-1 Full Mock Test 18 (Hard Level)
description: Full length SSC CGL Tier-1 mock test with 100 questions covering Reasoning, General Awareness, Quantitative Aptitude and English. Hard difficulty level. Duration 60 minutes.
instructions: This is a full length mock test for SSC CGL Tier-1.
Negative marking of 0.5 marks for each wrong answer.
There are 4 options for each question. Choose the correct one.
Questions are of Hard difficulty level.
Subjects: Reasoning (25), General Awareness (25), Quantitative Aptitude (25), English (25).
